title: Category Reassessment Carpet Treatment — Insurance Claim Services Schedule
content:
| Dispatched at | Recorded category | Carpet billed as detach and reset is also priced as | Rate (Standard Loss / Large Loss) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water or Gray Water tier | category 3 | carpet removal at the Black Water carpet removal rate | 0.52 / 0.47 per square foot |
| Clean Water tier | category 2 | pad removal at the Gray Water pad removal rate | 0.48 / 0.43 per square foot |
| any other | any | nothing | — |

**Rule.** For an Insurance Claim Services category reassessment supplement, the carpet treatment is set as follows: for a job dispatched at a Clean or Gray Water tier whose recorded category is category 3, the carpet area billed as detach and reset is also priced as carpet removal at the Black Water carpet removal rate, because black-water carpet may not be salvaged; for a job dispatched at a Clean Water tier whose recorded category is category 2, the same area is priced as pad removal at the Gray Water pad removal rate, because gray-water pad may not be salvaged; otherwise no carpet treatment.

The Water Damage Mitigation job supplies the tier, the recorded category, the affected area (Standard Loss below 2000 square feet, Large Loss at 2000 or more) and the square feet of carpet billed as detach and reset. Nothing is subtracted: the treatment is the area multiplied by the rate.

*Hypothetical:* 410 square feet of carpet billed as detach and reset on a Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss job of 1320 square feet, recorded category 3: 410 multiplied by 0.52 is 213.20. On a Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss job of 2300 square feet recorded category 2: 410 multiplied by 0.43 is 176.30.
